products.name: Item and Document Imaging Solutions

products.name: Cloud Hosting and Managed Services

products.name: Hardware and Peripheral Sales

products.name: Local Experiences and Services Marketplace
products.description: A digital marketplace connecting consumers with local and national merchants offering experiences and services such as things to do, beauty and wellness, food and drink, home and automotive services, and online services. products.name: Travel Experiences Marketplace

products.name: Digital Coupon Distribution

products.name: Claims Intelligence Solutions
products.description: A suite of data-driven algorithms and insights, including reference-based pricing, negotiation, and surprise bill services, that detect and address claims priced above fair market value, leveraging proprietary technology and AI to recommend or negotiate reimbursements for out-of-network medical costs. Delivered digitally via a platform integrated with payer workflows, often processed pre-payment and at scale.

products.name: Network Solutions
products.description: Provider network access and management services, including primary and complementary PPO networks, and outsourced network development and management, offering contracted discounts with over 1.4 million healthcare providers. Delivered through a technology platform that matches claims to network contracts and supports custom network builds for payers.

products.name: Payment and Revenue Integrity Solutions
products.description: Data, technology, and clinical expertise-driven services to identify improper, unnecessary, or excessive charges before or after claims are paid, and to restore underpaid premium dollars for government health plans. Includes pre-payment and post-payment integrity analytics, clinical negotiation, subrogation, and revenue integrity services, delivered via digital and expert-driven processes.

products.name: Data and Analytics Solutions
products.description: A suite of healthcare-focused data and advanced analytics products applying descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analytics to optimize benefit plan design, support payer and provider decision-making, improve clinical outcomes, and reduce total cost of care. Delivered as software platforms and analytic services, including price transparency tools, data warehouses, and risk modeling.

products.name: Supplemental Carrier Services
products.description: Technology-enabled services for supplemental and stop-loss health insurance carriers, integrating medical claims data to identify, notify, and pay supplemental benefits, increasing policy value for employer groups and policyholders. Delivered through digital integration and analytics.

products.name: AI-Powered Conversation Intelligence Solutions
products.description: A suite of AI-driven software products that analyze business conversations across phone, text, and other channels to provide actionable insights for sales, marketing, and customer engagement. Delivered digitally via cloud-based platforms and APIs, these solutions leverage generative AI, speech recognition, and data analytics to optimize customer acquisition and experience.

products.name: Marketing Attribution and Conversation Analytics Platform (Marketing Edge)
products.description: A digital platform that uses conversational intelligence and generative AI to track, analyze, and attribute marketing campaigns to inbound conversations and sales outcomes, enabling businesses to optimize marketing spend and improve revenue. Delivered as a cloud-based software solution.

products.name: Business Text Messaging Solutions (Sonar)
products.description: An AI-powered, workflow-enabled mobile messaging platform that allows businesses to communicate with prospects, customers, and field staff via two-way text messaging, automating and personalizing interactions to drive engagement and conversions. Delivered as a digital SaaS product.

products.name: Conversation Intelligence API Platform (Marchex Platform Services)
products.description: A robust API service that enables businesses to integrate Marchex's AI-powered conversation analytics into their own communication platforms, providing features such as call outcome analysis, speech-to-text transcription, and AI-generated call summaries. Delivered as a cloud-based API for enterprise integration.

products.name: AI Conversation Analytics for Multi-Location Businesses (Spotlight)
products.description: A specialized analytics product designed for enterprises with multiple locations, providing actionable insights and performance tracking across locations to improve call handling, sales outcomes, and brand loyalty. Delivered as a digital analytics platform.

products.name: Sales Engagement and Performance Optimization Solutions (Engage)
products.description: A digital solution that integrates call data with CRM systems to enhance sales engagement, improve appointment setting, and drive incremental sales, offering real-time alerts and insights for training and accountability. Delivered as a SaaS application for enterprise sales teams.

products.name: AI Call Summary and Sentiment Analysis Suite
products.description: A set of AI-powered tools that analyze and summarize consumer-to-business calls, identifying customer sentiment and experience quality to help businesses capitalize on positive interactions and address negative ones. Delivered as part of Marchex's digital product suite and via API.

products.name: AI for Industry Solution
products.description: An advanced AI-driven solution offering automatic lead qualification, improved marketing attribution, and conversion performance analytics tailored to specific industries, helping businesses target high-value opportunities and optimize sales funnels. Delivered as a digital analytics and automation platform.

products.name: Outdoor Recreation Products
products.description: A broad assortment of products for outdoor activities, including camping equipment, coolers, drinkware, watersports gear, fishing rods, marine equipment, hunting firearms, ammunition, archery equipment, camouflage apparel, waders, and related accessories. These are sourced from national and private label brands and sold through physical stores and e-commerce.

products.name: Sports and Recreation Equipment
products.description: A comprehensive range of equipment and accessories for fitness, team sports, specialty sports, and recreational activities, including fitness equipment, nutrition supplies, team sports gear, golf, racket sports, bicycles, skateboards, trampolines, and play sets. Products are offered via retail stores and online channels.

products.name: Apparel
products.description: A wide selection of outdoor, athletic, youth, licensed, and seasonal apparel for men, women, and children, including outerwear, denim, work apparel, graphic t-shirts, and accessories. Products are sourced from national and private label brands and sold in-store and online.

products.name: Footwear
products.description: A full range of footwear including casual, athletic, work, seasonal, youth, and team sports shoes and boots, sourced from leading national and private label brands. Sold through physical stores and e-commerce.

products.name: Private Label Brand Products
products.description: Exclusive products under 19 private label brands spanning outdoor, sports, apparel, and footwear categories, designed to fill gaps in national brand offerings and provide value-based alternatives. These are manufactured for and sold exclusively by the company.

products.name: E-commerce Retailing
products.description: Online sales of the full product assortment, including outdoor, sports, apparel, and footwear, with fulfillment via shipping or buy-online-pickup-in-store (BOPIS). Digital-only and omnichannel services are provided through the company website and app.

products.name: Gift Cards and Loyalty Programs
products.description: Sales of gift cards and operation of customer loyalty programs, including myAcademy Rewards, which provide incentives and rewards for purchases across all product categories. These programs are managed digitally and in-store.

products.name: Homeowners Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage for homeowners, primarily focused on low-value dwelling insurance tailored for owners of lower valued homes. These products are underwritten and delivered through independent managing general agents, with policies written on both admitted and excess and surplus lines basis, and are currently offered in Texas, Illinois, and Indiana.

products.name: Dwelling Fire Insurance
products.description: Insurance products providing coverage for dwelling fire risks, offered to individuals as part of the personal insurance lines. These are underwritten and delivered through independent agents and MGAs, and require regulated insurance infrastructure for policy issuance and claims handling.

products.name: Knee Reconstruction and Replacement Products
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and markets implants and instruments for total and partial knee replacement surgeries, including primary and revision procedures. Delivered through physical manufacturing and supported by digital and robotic technologies for implant positioning.

products.name: Hip Reconstruction and Replacement Products
products.description: Produces and sells implants and instruments for total and partial hip replacement surgeries, including primary and revision procedures. Products are physically manufactured and may use bone cement or press-fit technologies, with robotic assistance available.

products.name: Sports Medicine, Extremities, and Trauma (S.E.T.) Products
products.description: Offers a broad portfolio of physically manufactured products for sports medicine (soft tissue repair), biologics (joint preservation/support), foot and ankle, upper extremities (shoulder, elbow, wrist), trauma (bone stabilization), and craniomaxillofacial/thoracic reconstruction. Delivered to healthcare providers for surgical use.

products.name: Craniomaxillofacial and Thoracic (CMFT) Products
products.description: Manufactures and markets products for face and skull reconstruction and for fixation/stabilization of chest bones, used in healing or reconstruction after surgery, trauma, or deformities. Delivered as physical implants and devices to healthcare institutions.

products.name: Bone Cement Products
products.description: Produces and supplies bone cement and related mixing/delivery products used to assist with implant fixation in orthopedic surgeries. These are physically manufactured and distributed to surgical centers and hospitals.

products.name: Surgical Products and Solutions
products.description: Provides a portfolio of surgical instruments and solutions used by healthcare institutions in orthopedic and related surgeries. These are physically manufactured and distributed to hospitals and surgical centers.

products.name: Integrated Digital and Robotic Technologies (ZBEdge Platform)
products.description: Markets a suite of digital and robotic technologies, including data analytics and artificial intelligence, that connect and collect data before, during, and after surgery to assist surgeons in decision-making and implant positioning. Delivered as software and hardware platforms integrated with surgical procedures.

products.name: LPG Transportation Services
products.description: Ownership and operation of a fleet of very large gas carriers (VLGCs) to provide international seaborne transportation of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) for third-party customers. This service is delivered via physical maritime shipping assets, requiring significant capital investment, technical management, and compliance with global maritime regulations.

products.name: Ammonia Transportation Services
products.description: Provision of international seaborne transportation of ammonia using purpose-built VLGC/Ammonia Carriers (VLGC/ACs) capable of carrying both LPG and ammonia. This service is delivered via specialized vessels and requires compliance with additional safety and regulatory standards for ammonia cargoes.

products.name: Commercial Vessel Management Services
products.description: Provision of in-house commercial management services for owned and third-party vessels, including those deployed in the Helios Pool. This service involves managing vessel employment, chartering, and revenue pooling, and is delivered through specialized commercial teams and digital platforms.

products.name: Technical Vessel Management Services
products.description: Provision of in-house technical management services for owned vessels, including maintenance, crewing, regulatory compliance, and safety management. This service is delivered by shore-based technical teams and requires expertise in vessel operations and adherence to international maritime standards.

products.name: Magnesium Alloys and Engineered Magnesium Products
products.description: Manufactured specialty magnesium alloys and products, including billets, sheet, coil, and tooling plate, for lightweighting, corrosion resistance, and thermal performance in aerospace, defense, automotive, energy, and industrial applications. Production involves advanced metallurgy and proprietary alloying processes.

products.name: Magnesium Powders and Specialty Magnesium Products
products.description: Produced magnesium powders and specialty products for use in aircraft countermeasure flares, infrared decoys, heating elements for self-heating meals, and specialized defense and emergency-relief applications. Manufacturing requires fine powder processing and safety controls.

products.name: Zirconium-Based Chemicals and Compounds
products.description: Manufactures zirconium-based chemicals and oxides for use in automotive catalytic converters, industrial catalysis, advanced ceramics, specialty glass, fuel cell components, pharmaceuticals, and environmental remediation. Production involves chemical processing of zircon sand and rare earth elements.

products.name: High-Pressure Gas Cylinders (Aluminum and Carbon Composite)
products.description: Designs and manufactures specialized high-pressure gas cylinders using aluminum alloys and carbon composite technologies for applications in emergency response, healthcare, aerospace, alternative fuel transportation, and specialty industrial markets. Production involves advanced composite winding and metal forming.

products.name: Alternative Fuel Storage and Transportation Cylinders
products.description: Produces carbon composite cylinders and multi-element gas container systems for on-vehicle storage and bulk transportation of compressed natural gas (CNG) and hydrogen, serving buses, trucks, and hydrogen mobility infrastructure. Manufacturing uses proprietary composite technologies and system integration.

products.name: Aerospace and Space Gas Cylinders
products.description: Manufactures specialized gas cylinders for aerospace and space applications, including aircraft safety systems (emergency slide inflation, onboard oxygen) and space launch vehicles. Production requires high-strength materials and stringent quality controls.

products.name: Medical Gas Cylinders
products.description: Produces aluminum and composite cylinders for the storage and delivery of medical gases, serving hospitals, emergency services, laboratories, and home healthcare. Manufacturing involves precision forming and compliance with medical standards.

products.name: Specialty Aluminum Cylinder Solutions
products.description: Manufactures specialty aluminum cylinders for industrial, specialty gas, and transportation applications requiring high strength-to-weight performance. Production uses advanced metal forming and finishing processes.

products.name: Dissolvable Magnesium Alloys for Oil and Gas
products.description: Develops and manufactures dissolvable magnesium alloys (e.g., SoluMag®) for use in hydraulic fracturing and downhole oil and gas applications, enabling improved well productivity and reduced intervention costs. Production involves proprietary alloying and forming processes.

products.name: Pharmaceutical and Biomedical Materials
products.description: Produces zirconium-based compounds and MELsorb® materials for use in pharmaceutical manufacturing, dialysis equipment, enterosorbents, and biomedical applications. Manufacturing involves chemical synthesis and purification processes.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides loans to commercial clients, including commercial loans, commercial real estate loans, agricultural loans, letters of credit, and lease financing. products.name: Consumer Lending

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a range of deposit accounts to individuals and businesses, including checking, savings, money market, and time deposits, with access via physical branches, ATMs, online, and mobile banking. Requires regulated infrastructure and technology platforms.

products.name: Wealth Management and Private Banking
products.description: Delivers wealth management, trust, investment advisory, and private banking services to individuals and institutions, involving personalized financial planning, asset management, and fiduciary services. Delivered through specialized teams and digital platforms.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides securities brokerage services, enabling clients to buy and sell securities and access investment products. Delivered through licensed representatives and digital channels, requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Treasury Management and Merchant Services
products.description: Offers treasury management and merchant services to business clients, including cash management, payment processing, and related financial solutions. Delivered via specialized teams and digital platforms, requiring secure and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Capital Markets Services
products.description: Provides capital markets services such as underwriting, advisory, and access to financial markets for institutional and business clients. Delivered through specialized teams and digital platforms, requiring financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Community Development Lending and Equity Investment Solutions
products.description: Offers community development lending and equity investment solutions aimed at producing jobs and revitalizing communities. Involves specialized lending and investment activities, often in partnership with public or nonprofit entities.

products.name: Foreign Currency Services
products.description: Provides foreign currency services to clients, including currency exchange and international payment solutions. Delivered through banking centers and digital channels, requiring compliance with financial regulations.

products.name: Aquadex System (including Aquadex FlexFlow and Aquadex SmartFlow)
products.description: A medical device system for ultrafiltration therapy, designed and manufactured by Nuwellis, used to remove excess fluid from adult and pediatric patients with fluid overload unresponsive to medical management. The system includes a console (capital equipment), disposable blood circuit sets, and disposable catheters, and is delivered in both inpatient and outpatient healthcare settings. The system is manufactured using electromechanical pumps, filtration technology, and requires regulated medical device infrastructure.

products.name: Dedicated Pediatric Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy (CRRT) Device (Vivian)
products.description: A specialized medical device under development for continuous renal replacement therapy in pediatric patients weighing 2.5 kg and above who require kidney replacement therapy. The device is being engineered to address the unique needs of neonates and small children, with commercialization expected in the future. It involves physical manufacturing, regulated device development, and clinical validation.

products.name: Biologic Therapies for Autoimmune Diseases
products.description: Monoclonal antibody-based biologic therapies, including JADE101, JADE201, and JADE301, developed through proprietary discovery and engineering platforms. These are manufactured using licensed cell lines and delivered via subcutaneous or intravenous injection, targeting specific immune pathways for disease modification in autoimmune disorders.

products.name: Door Controls, Door Control Systems, and Exit Devices
products.description: Manufactured hardware products including mechanical door closers, automatic door operators, exit devices (panic hardware), and complete door control systems, typically installed on fire doors and facility entrances/exits for life-safety and security. Delivered as physical products, often requiring professional installation and compliance with safety codes.

products.name: Doors, Glass and Door Systems, and Accessories
products.description: Manufactured hollow metal doors, glass and specialty door systems, and a variety of door accessories such as hinges, pulls, stops, louvers, weather stripping, and thresholds, designed for security and functional needs in commercial and institutional buildings. Delivered as physical products, often custom-configured and installed on-site.

products.name: Electronic Security Products and Access Control Systems
products.description: A broad range of electronic locks, electronic door closers and exit devices, access control systems, credential readers, and cloud-based solutions for managing and monitoring access, attendance, and workforce productivity. Delivered as integrated hardware and software, often requiring installation and ongoing digital management.

products.name: Locks, Locksets, Portable Locks, and Key Systems
products.description: Manufactured mechanical and electronic locks, locksets (cylindrical, tubular, mortise), security levers, master key systems, and portable security products such as bicycle and travel locks, for both commercial and residential use. Delivered as physical products, often requiring professional installation and key management.

products.name: Security Services and Software Solutions
products.description: Planned inspection, maintenance, and repair services for automatic entrance solutions, as well as design, installation, and ongoing aftermarket services. Includes software-as-a-service (SaaS) offerings for access control, platform integration, and workforce management, delivered digitally or through on-site service teams.

products.name: PI3Kα Inhibitor Therapies (Zovegalisib)
products.description: Small molecule therapies targeting PI3Kα mutations, developed using proprietary Motion-Based Drug Design®, delivered as oral drugs for precision oncology (breast cancer, solid tumors) and genetic diseases (vascular anomalies). Manufactured via synthetic chemistry and administered to patients in clinical settings.

products.name: NRAS-Selective Inhibitor Therapies (RLY-8161)
products.description: Oral small molecule therapies selectively inhibiting NRAS-mutated proteins in solid tumors, designed to spare other RAS isoforms, produced via synthetic chemistry and delivered to patients in clinical trials for cancers such as melanoma, colorectal, and non-small-cell lung cancer.

products.name: Non-Inhibitory Chaperone Therapy for Fabry Disease
products.description: Investigational small molecule chaperone designed to stabilize the αGal protein in Fabry disease without inhibiting its activity, enabling greater substrate clearance. Manufactured synthetically and intended for chronic oral administration, either as monotherapy or in combination with enzyme replacement therapy.

products.name: FGFR2 Inhibitor Therapies (Lirafugratinib, Partnered)
products.description: Oral small molecule inhibitors targeting FGFR2-driven cancers, developed and previously owned by the company, now globally licensed to Elevar Therapeutics for further development and commercialization. Manufactured via synthetic chemistry and administered to patients with FGFR2-driven cholangiocarcinoma and other solid tumors.

products.name: Precision Oncology and Genetic Disease Discovery Programs
products.description: Early-stage discovery and preclinical programs leveraging the Dynamo® platform to develop novel small molecule therapies for genetically validated targets in oncology and monogenic genetic diseases. These programs use computational and experimental approaches to identify and optimize drug candidates for future clinical development.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of one- to four-family residential mortgage loans, primarily secured by owner-occupied properties, with a mix of fixed and adjustable rates, offered through in-person and digital channels, and sometimes sold into the secondary market. Requires regulated underwriting, property appraisals, and compliance with secondary market guidelines.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of fixed and adjustable-rate mortgage loans secured by commercial real estate, including office, retail, and industrial properties, primarily for small business owners and professionals. Loans are secured by first mortgages and require regulated underwriting and risk assessment.

products.name: Single Tenant Net Lease (NNN) Finance Program
products.description: Origination of commercial real estate loans to high net worth individuals, secured by low loan-to-value, single-tenant commercial properties leased to investment grade national-brand retailers, often outside the primary market area. Involves large loan sizes and specialized risk management.

products.name: Construction Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for the construction of one- to four-family homes and commercial properties, including speculative and pre-sold projects, with funds disbursed based on project completion and requiring inspections. Loans are typically short-term, interest-only, and require regulated underwriting and collateral assessment.

products.name: Land and Land Development Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to developers and individuals for the purchase and development of vacant land, typically for residential subdivisions or investment purposes, with short-term, interest-only structures and regulated underwriting.

products.name: Multi-Family Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of mortgage loans secured by multi-family residential properties, typically within the primary market area, with regulated underwriting, first mortgages, and risk assessment based on property and borrower characteristics.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans including home equity loans (fixed and adjustable), auto and truck loans, personal loans, and small boat loans, primarily to individuals. Loans are underwritten based on creditworthiness and collateral value, and delivered through branch and digital channels.

products.name: Commercial Business Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to small businesses, secured by equipment and general business assets, with terms and covenants tailored to borrower risk and typically requiring personal guarantees. Delivered through relationship banking and in-person channels.

products.name: SBA 7(a) Program Lending
products.description: Origination and sale of loans guaranteed by the U.S. Small Business Administration under the 7(a) program, with borrowers and collateral often outside the primary market area. The guaranteed portions are sold in the secondary market, while unguaranteed portions are retained for interest income.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a broad selection of deposit accounts to consumers and businesses, including non-interest-bearing and interest-bearing demand accounts, savings accounts, and time deposits, delivered through branch and digital channels. Requires regulated infrastructure and compliance.

products.name: Site Leasing Services
products.description: Leasing of antenna space on multi-tenant towers and other structures to wireless service providers under long-term contracts. This involves physical infrastructure ownership, management, and leasing, both domestically and internationally.

products.name: Site Development Services
products.description: Provision of end-to-end services for wireless network development, including network pre-design, site audits, site identification, leasing support, zoning and permitting, construction, antenna and radio equipment installation, commissioning, and maintenance. Delivered primarily through in-person labor and project management in the U.S.

products.name: Edge Data Center Services
products.description: Ownership and operation of regional and tower-based data centers to support edge computing infrastructure for wireless and internet service providers. These are physical facilities located at or near tower sites, enabling customers to deploy computing capabilities closer to end users.

products.name: Open-Access Network Deployment Services
products.description: Deployment of open-access networks for real estate developers, providing network infrastructure accessible throughout community common areas and amenities. Involves physical installation and integration of network systems.

products.name: NEO100 Intranasal Therapy for Brain Cancers
products.description: A purified form of perillyl alcohol (POH) administered via intranasal delivery for the treatment of primary and secondary brain cancers, including malignant glioma and meningioma. The product is manufactured as ultra-pure, pharmaceutical-grade NEO100 and delivered using a nebulizer mask, allowing for non-invasive, self-administered treatment that bypasses the blood-brain barrier.

products.name: NEO212 Oral and Intranasal Therapy for Brain and Peripheral Cancers
products.description: A covalently conjugated molecule combining temozolomide and perillyl alcohol, designed for enhanced blood-brain barrier penetration and activity against brain cancers (glioblastoma, brain metastases) and peripheral cancers (e.g., melanoma, lung, breast, leukemia). Delivered orally for primary and metastatic brain tumors and in development for intranasal delivery for brain metastases. Manufactured as a bioconjugated oral formulation and planned for intranasal application.

products.name: NEO100 as a Drug Delivery Vehicle (Intranasal and Intra-arterial)
products.description: NEO100 used as a solvent and delivery vehicle for co-administration with other pharmaceuticals (e.g., levodopa for Parkinson’s disease, doxorubicin for pediatric brain tumors), either intranasally or via intra-arterial injection to facilitate drug entry into the brain by bypassing or temporarily opening the blood-brain barrier. This approach is in preclinical or early clinical development and involves physical manufacturing of NEO100 and combination with other drugs.

products.name: NEO100/NEO212 Conjugated Drug Delivery Platform
products.description: A platform for creating novel fusion compounds by covalently conjugating NEO100 to other therapeutic agents (e.g., temozolomide, rolipram, valproic acid, 3-bromopyruvate, linoleic acid) to enhance blood-brain barrier penetration and therapeutic activity against brain and other cancers. These are manufactured as new chemical entities and are in preclinical or early clinical development.

products.name: AI-Driven Drug Discovery and 3D Bioprinting Platforms (for External Collaboration/Licensing)
products.description: Artificial intelligence–powered compound modeling and sonodynamic therapy optimization, and magnetic-field-guided 3D bioprinting technology for generating tumor spheroids and organoids. These platforms are used for high-throughput drug screening, mechanism-of-action studies, and disease modeling, and are positioned for potential external licensing and collaborations with academic institutions and biotech firms.

products.name: Acoustic Disinfection and Purification Devices
products.description: Ultrasonic-based hardware products for sterilization and air purification in commercial and household settings, leveraging non-audible mechanical wave effects and sometimes integrating UV and plasma functions. Manufactured in China and distributed globally, including the U.S.

products.name: Acoustic Health and Wellness Devices
products.description: Smart hardware products applying acoustic and resonance principles (e.g., Schumann resonance) for sleep aid, relaxation, and health management, including non-contact sleep aid devices and portable solutions for individual consumers. Delivered through both B2B and B2C channels.

products.name: Acoustic Medical and Beauty Devices
products.description: Professional and personal-use devices utilizing precise sound wave technology for cosmetic care, body shaping, and non-invasive medical interventions, including ultrasonic wrinkle removal, fat reduction, and neuro-regulation devices. Distributed to beauty salons, health management companies, and individuals.

products.name: Acoustic Industrial and Agricultural Equipment
products.description: Ultrasonic and acoustic-based devices for industrial precision processing (e.g., 3D metal printing, nano-material preparation), agricultural pest control, crop growth promotion, and product preservation. Delivered to industrial manufacturers and agricultural producers.

products.name: Acoustic Technology Licensing and Embedded Modules
products.description: Licensing of proprietary acoustic technologies and provision of embedded modules (hardware/software) to third-party partners for integration into their products, generating revenue through technology output and profit-sharing without large-scale manufacturing.

products.name: Comprehensive Acoustic Solutions (Hardware + AI + Services)
products.description: End-to-end solutions integrating acoustic hardware, AI platform functions, and supporting services tailored to customer needs in sectors such as healthcare, beauty, and industrial applications. Includes R&D, product delivery, and application support.

products.name: AI Multimodal Intelligence Service Platform
products.description: A self-developed software platform leveraging AI and multimodal data processing (text, voice, image, video) to provide real-time data collection, analysis, generation, and business process automation for enterprise and individual clients. Delivered as SaaS, pay-per-use, or customized solutions.

products.name: AI Multimodal Digital Solutions for SMEs
products.description: Industry-specific digital solutions for small and medium enterprises, integrating membership management, data analysis, intelligent marketing, and business process automation, delivered via the AI multimodal platform as standardized or customized services.

products.name: Digital Rural Services Platform

products.name: New Media Marketing and Digital Content Services
products.description: Customizable digital marketing management systems and services, including content publishing, user interaction analysis, and marketing effectiveness tracking, powered by AI multimodal data processing for enterprises and media partners.

products.name: Transportation Infrastructure Construction Services
products.description: Design and construction of bridges, roadways, marine structures, dredging, ship terminals, piers, and specialty structures and facilities such as convention centers, sports stadiums, and Ferris wheels. Delivered via large-scale, equipment-intensive construction projects for public and private clients.

Delivered globally to automotive OEMs and replacement markets.

products.name: Fluid Handling Systems
products.description: Manufactured systems for fuel and brake delivery and fluid transfer in vehicles, including fuel lines, brake lines, quick connectors, coolant hoses, and thermal management tubing. These products are produced using specialized materials and processes to sense, deliver, connect, and control fluids for optimal vehicle operation, and are supplied globally to automotive OEMs and replacement markets.

products.name: Industrial and Specialty Group (ISG) Products
products.description: OEM-quality sealing and fluid handling solutions adapted for diverse transportation and industrial markets outside of automotive, leveraging the company's core engineering and manufacturing expertise. These are physically manufactured products tailored for non-automotive and specialty applications.

products.name: Reduced Nicotine Content (RNC) Cigarettes (VLN® and Partner Brands)
